* Earn while you study a Master’s degree through UNSW
* Gain hands\-on experience across strategy, operations and health leadership

  

  

**Build your future in health management – manage projects, solve complex problems and create better health services across Western Sydney.**

  



**Employment Type:** Temporary Full Time (01/02/2027 up to 02/02/2029\)
  

**Position Classification:** Administration Officer Level 4
  

**Remuneration:** $39\.43 \- $40\.33 per hour

**Location:** Western Sydney Local Health District  

  

  

  

  

  

**Where you'll be working**
  

Join Western Sydney Local Health District (WSLHD) and gain an inside view of one of Australia’s largest and most complex public health systems. The Graduate Health Management Program is designed for emerging professionals who want to turn their potential into a rewarding career in health service management and leadership.


* Work alongside experienced health managers and senior executives across Western Sydney.
* Gain exposure to strategic and operational priorities across the health service.
* Build networks with professionals across hospitals, programs and corporate functions.
* Access structured professional development in leadership, governance, project management and performance.

Balance paid full\-time employment with postgraduate study through the University of New South Wales (UNSW).  
* 

**What you'll be doing**
  

As a Health Management Intern, you’ll combine practical experience with postgraduate study, developing the skills and confidence to contribute to the future of health services. You’ll be trusted to take ownership of meaningful work while learning from experienced leaders.


* Deliver projects and develop practical plans that support strategic and operational priorities.
* Analyse complex issues, solve problems and contribute to informed management decisions.
* Prepare high\-quality presentations, briefs and correspondence for a range of stakeholders.
* Participate in executive and hospital\-level meetings covering service delivery, finance, performance, digital and governance.
* Build your understanding of the NSW Health System while actively pursuing your professional and academic development.

  

  

**Ready to make your mark in health management?**
  

Join the team enriching health in millions of ways every day. Bring your curiosity, ambition and commitment to continuous learning to Western Sydney Local Health District and build a career that makes a difference to your community.

At Ramsay Pharmacy, we are more than just Australia’s leading Community \& Hospital Pharmacy network. We are part of Ramsay Health care, proudly employing more than 90,000 of the best people who expertly look after millions of patients across 10 countries globally every year.

 **Job Description**  

The Ramsay Pharmacy Internship Program is designed to equip interns with the foundational knowledge, skills and confidence required to become capable and skilled pharmacists.

* Comprehensive support as you work towards achieving your supervised practice hours, helping you develop your pharmacy knowledge and practical skills.
* Access to weekly tutorials, workbooks, quizzes and exam preparation.

**Your Role**

* Work alongside experienced pharmacists to accurately dispense medications, support medication management and provide medication information to patients.
* Collaborate with healthcare professionals to support seamless patient care and contribute to day\-to\-day pharmacy operations.
* Maintain compliance with regulations and ethical guidelines while prioritising patient safety and confidentiality.

**What We Offer**

* A leading\-edge program to support your transition from study to clinical practice, including professional development through the Ramsay Pharmacy Academy
* A hardcopy AMH to support your oral exam preparation, plus access to scholarships, training programs and external courses
* Participation in our Intern of the Year program, with the winner receiving AHPRA registration and SHPA/PSA membership paid for in 2027
* Opportunities to attend industry conferences and explore career pathways across hospital, community, operations and leadership
* Attractive remuneration, employee benefits and work flexibility to support work\-life balance

**St George Private Hospital**


Join the supportive team at **Ramsay Pharmacy St George**, located within St George Private Hospital in Kogarah, and gain hands\-on experience across both **hospital and community pharmacy**. With exposure to **Oncology, Cardiology, Orthopaedics, Maternity, Surgical and Medical services**, you’ll build a strong foundation for a rewarding clinical career. Our interns have gone on to become **clinical pharmacists on the wards and in Oncology**, offering exciting opportunities for future career development. You’ll also benefit from a supportive team, specialised services and convenient public transport access. Our two interns **alternate fortnightly between day shifts (8am–4pm) and evening shifts (3pm–11pm)**, giving you a well\-rounded experience from day one!

 **Qualifications** **About You**

* Strong communication skills and empathy
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment
* Confidence to make informed decisions and take ownership of your practice

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Full working rights in Australia or New Zealand
* Bachelor of Pharmacy or equivalent qualification (this must be completed before commencing internship)
* Be provisionally registered with AHPRA by early 2027\.

**About the Department**
------------------------



The Department of Industry, Science and Resources and our broader portfolio are integral to the Australian Government’s economic agenda. Our purpose is to help the government build a better future for all Australians through enabling a productive, resilient and sustainable economy, enriched by science and technology. We do this by:


* Growing innovative \& competitive businesses, industries and regions
* Investing in science and technology
* Strengthening the resources sector.


The APS and the department offer a clear direction and meaningful work. You will be able to create positive impact in people’s lives whilst contributing to improved outcomes for Australia and our people.  

  

If you would like to feel a strong connection to your work and you are accountable, committed and open to change, join us in shaping Australia’s future.  

  

Please see the APSC’s APS Employee Value Proposition for more information on the benefits and value of employment within the APS.  

**About the team**
------------------



The National Measurement Institute (NMI) is the Australian Government’s authority on measurement, responsible for maintaining and advancing Australia’s measurement system. NMI delivers world\-class measurement standards, products and services that underpin confidence in trade, regulation and scientific research, with international recognition of its standards and capabilities.  

  

Within NMI, the Chemical and Biological Metrology Branch develops and delivers chemical and biological measurement standards, including certified reference materials and proficiency testing programs that support laboratory quality and performance. The Chemical Reference Materials section focuses on the production and certification of high\-quality organic reference materials for calibration, supporting critical sectors such as sports doping control, forensic science, environmental and food testing, ensuring alignment with international best practice and accreditation requirements. It is expected that our ideal candidate will support and promote NMI’s vision, mission and business objectives, by actively contributing to the team’s goals, strategies and work schedule while achieving quality outcomes and adhering to documented procedures.


**The opportunity**
-------------------



Join a high\-impact team at the National Measurement Institute and contribute to work that supports national and international stakeholders by underpinning confidence in chemical analytical testing results, worldwide. This role offers a unique opportunity to apply your analytical chemistry and quality systems expertise in an internationally recognised, accredited laboratory.  

  

Through hands\-on experience, you will strengthen your technical capability in organic analytical chemistry, using chromatography and a range of analytical techniques, while developing analytical skills for purity assignment and associated measurement uncertainty calculations. You will maintain the Chemical Reference Material’s Quality System in alignment with ISO/IEC 17025 and ISO 17034\. As part of a collaborative team, you will contribute to method validation, laboratory audits, continuous improvement initiatives, and the preparation of certificates of analysis and Quality System documentation.  

  

You will build expertise in laboratory quality assurance and accreditation practices, strengthening your professional profile through hands\-on experience in delivering reliable, traceable measurement outcomes that are trusted both nationally and internationally.


**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------



At NMI you will join a world leader in measurement science. NMI has a diverse range of roles and priorities that will present the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your career in interesting and exciting ways. As part of the department, employees at NMI are covered by the relevant enterprise agreement and benefits include:  



* 15\.4% employer superannuation contribution.
* 4 weeks annual leave per year.
* 18 days paid personal leave per year.
* Maternity and paternity leave.
* A vacation care subsidy.
* $235 healthy lifestyle subsidy.
* Salary packaging which allows you to make certain payments using your pre\-tax salary.
* Access to study assistance.
* Access to staff counselling services.


**Our ideal candidate**
-----------------------



Our ideal candidate will demonstrate:  



* Knowledge and practical application of ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 17034, measurement uncertainty, and associated technical standards and guidelines to support quality assurance activities within a laboratory environment.
* Experience with documented Quality Systems and response to preventative and corrective actions.
* Knowledge of laboratory environments with practical experience or familiarity with analytical chemistry techniques such as gas and liquid chromatography, Karl Fischer, and thermogravimetric analysis.
* Demonstrated experience in the operation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and performance verification of analytical instrumentation, including gas chromatography with flame ionisation detection (GC\-FID) and high\-performance liquid chromatography with ultraviolet detection (HPLC\-UV), to ensure reliable and compliant laboratory operations.
* Experience in the preparation of stock and working solutions using accurate gravimetric techniques, and proficiency in the operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and documentation of ampouling processes and associated equipment within a quality\-managed laboratory environment.
* Pro\-active approach to continuous improvement of the work program and Quality System.
* Written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to contribute to Quality System documentation and report writing.


**What you will do**
--------------------



As the Quality Officer, your key duties are:  



* Reporting to the senior scientist, maintain the Quality Systems for the laboratory in line with the accreditation requirements in accordance with ISO 17034\.
* Review laboratory techniques, standard operating procedures, method documents, and the overarching Quality Manual to support reference material production in alignment with changing requirements and circumstances.
* Support the Senior Scientist in quality assurance activities, including the management of investigations, corrective actions, process improvements to prevent the recurrence of non\-conformances, and participation in internal and external audits.
* Perform routine stability analysis and analytical testing using established methods (e.g. chromatography and related techniques) and submit excel workbooks and certificates of analysis to senior staff for review.
* Perform the calibration of analytical balances and performance check of specialised analytical instrumentation, maintaining schedules and documented records in the group’s electronic database.
* Participate in and evaluate international interlaboratory comparison and proficiency testing programs, analysing statistical performance data to verify measurement competence, support method validation, and demonstrate the metrological traceability and technical capability of the reference material production process.


**Eligibility**
---------------



A Bachelor of Science in Chemistry with demonstrated knowledge of organic analytical chemistry.



To be eligible for employment in the APS and the department, candidates must be Australian Citizens.  

  

Positions require a Baseline security clearance and successful candidates will be required to obtain and maintain a clearance at this level.


**Notes**
---------



A merit pool may be established and used to fill future vacancies within 18 months from the date the vacancy was first advertised in the Gazette.  

  

The department does currently offer flexible work opportunities for many roles. This vacancy is North Ryde based and is conducted on site. There is limited capacity to work flexibility outside of an ad\-hoc basis. Please reach out to the contact officer to discuss this further.


**Application information**
---------------------------



Your application must not contain any classified or sensitive information. This includes in your application responses, CV and any other documents. The selection panel may not consider applications containing classified information.  

  

Please provide a pitch explaining how your skills, knowledge and experience will be relevant to this role and why you are the best candidate for the position. Your pitch can contain no more than 500 words and should align to the key duties listed above.  

  

You may use AI tools to support your application. However, all content must be accurate, authentic, and reflect your own capability in line with APS merit principles. For further guidance, please refer to the APSC’s Principles for candidate use of AI in recruitment.  

  

Please complete your application online and provide your current CV with your application. (CVs must be in .doc, .docx, or .pdf format).  

  

Accessible application documentation is available in other formats on request. Please contact recruitment@industry.gov.au or (02\) 6276 1235 if you require assistance with your application.  

  

Please refer to our Applying for a position information for additional information on how to apply.

**About the Role**

The College Counsellor/Psychologist plays an important role in promoting students’ psychological health, social and emotional wellbeing, engagement and academic success. * Experience supporting the psychological, social and emotional wellbeing of school\-aged children and adolescents across differing developmental stages.

### **Who We Are**



Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy\-sensitive AI\-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.



We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100\+ of the Fortune 500\), a $5\.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.



You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries.


#### **About the Role**



Verkada is seeking an ambitious, high\-performing **Channel Sales Manager (CSM)** to shape, expand, and drive our channel and alliance footprint across New South Wales.



This is a high\-visibility, co\-selling, and partner\-hunting role tasked with building out our NSW partner ecosystem to drive exponential growth. You will take end\-to\-end ownership of regional channel strategy, actively activating tier\-1 Systems Integrators (SIs), top IT VARs, and regional distributors to generate net\-new, partner\-sourced enterprise deal registrations while displacing legacy, entrenched hardware incumbents.



Our mission is clear: to protect people and places in a privacy\-sensitive way. Verkada's cloud\-based technology is transforming physical security across industries like healthcare, education, retail, government, and industrial infrastructure. In this role, you will bridge the gap between enterprise IT SaaS economics and physical security deployment, positioning Verkada into major multi\-year RFPs, infrastructure master service agreements (MSAs), and large\-scale enterprise projects across NSW.

This position is based in Sydney, New South Wales, with regular travel across the state for partner enablement sessions, executive partner meetings, joint customer site walkthroughs, and channel ecosystem events, as well as occasional interstate or international travel.



While you have the flexibility to work remotely across NSW, you will have full access to Verkada's workspace in Sydney, which we actively encourage our team to use for team collaboration, deal strategy, partner workshops, and joint customer engagements.



#### **The Verkada Chanel Motion \& Go\-To\-Market Engine**



Our GTM channel engine combines executive alliance management, dedicated joint pipeline creation, field marketing support, structured sales execution, and strong co\-selling leverage.


* Partner\-Sourced Pipeline Generation: You work directly with partners, solution engineers, and business development teams to hunt net\-new business, driving partner\-sourced deal registrations as your primary commercial metric.

* Partner\-Sourced Deal Registration Acceleration: Actively co\-sell with partner sales teams to identify, qualify, and register net\-new enterprise opportunities, driving high deal velocity from initial lead to close.

* Field Presence \& Office Collaboration: Maintain an active presence in the field across NSW while utilising our Sydney office space to collaborate with regional teammates, partner leadership, and joint customer teams.

#### **What You Bring**


* Experience: 10\+ years of quota\-carrying channel sales, partner management, or alliance leadership experience within enterprise software, networking, cybersecurity, or cloud infrastructure, with a proven track record of driving partner\-sourced pipelines.
